comment: Every MIME type an Android content provider might use for an archive.
This list is read by two things that must never disagree: the file picker
(src/archive/pick.ts) and the 'Open with' intent filter that the config
plugin writes into AndroidManifest.xml. When they drifted apart, a .rar on
the phone appeared greyed out in the picker AND EzUnpack was missing from
the Open with list, from a single missing entry.
There is no authoritative spelling. Samsung's MediaStore reports .rar as
'application/x-rar-compressed' for the same file. Anything unidentified
arrives as 'application/octet-stream', which is why that stays in the list
even though it also matches unrelated files: a visible-but-untappable
archive stops the user dead, while a few extra rows only ask them to scroll.
